name: W Auto Page Preloader
author: Adnan Hyder Pervez

sections.description:
WAPPLOADER (WordPress Auto Page Pre-Loader) is a simple yet powerful plugin that displays a loading screen before your site content is fully visible.
It helps reduce bounce rate and improves user experience by giving your visitors an engaging animated pre-loader while pages are loading.

✨ Key Features

  • Enable or disable the pre-loader globally with one click.
  • Upload a custom logo or image for your loader.
  • Customize loader width and height (default: 250px × 250px).
  • Set duration time for how long the loader stays after page load.
  • Choose a background color OR upload a background image.
  • Background image controls: size (cover, contain, auto) and position (top, bottom, center, left, right).
  • Smooth animation effect that fills the loader image as the page loads.
  • Mobile-friendly and responsive.
  • Easy-to-use admin interface with live preview of loader and background.
sections.installation:
1. Download the WAPPLOADER plugin .zip file.
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel.
  3. Go to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Choose the .zip file and click Install Now.
  5. Once installed, click Activate Plugin.
  6. Navigate to WAPPLOADER in your WordPress dashboard to configure settings.
sections.faq:
1. Can I disable the pre-loader on specific pages?

Currently, the pre-loader is enabled site-wide. A per-page option may be added in future updates.

2. What happens if I set both a background color and a background image?

The plugin will automatically disable background color when a background image is selected.

3. Can I change the speed of the animation?

The duration setting allows you to control how long the loader remains after the page has loaded.

4. Will this slow down my site?

No. WAPPLOADER uses lightweight CSS and JavaScript for animations. It runs asynchronously and removes itself once loading completes.
